question: Which of the following **correctly **reflects the rank and medal performance at the 38th National Games 2025 held in Uttarakhand?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SSCB: 1st - 121 medals**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• The **Services Sports Control Board (SSCB)** secured the **1st rank** in the **38th National Games 2025** held in Uttarakhand with a total of **121 medals**. 
 
• Out of these, SSCB achieved a remarkable tally of **51 gold medals**, which significantly contributed to their top position. 
 
• The **National Games**, often regarded as a prestigious multi-sport event in India, witnessed intense competition among states and institutions in 2025. 
 
• SSCB, known for its consistent dominance in sports, has a strong track record of excelling in disciplines such as **athletics, boxing, wrestling, and shooting**. 
 
• The **Games** serve as a platform to nurture talent and prepare athletes for international competitions like the **Olympics** and **Asian Games**. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 
 
• **About the National Games:** 
 
 
• The **National Games** is a multi-sport event conducted every four years, bringing together athletes from different states and union territories, as well as institutional teams like SSCB. 
 
• The 38th edition of the Games in **2025** was hosted by **Uttarakhand** and featured over 36 sports disciplines. 
 
• This edition emphasized promoting sports culture across the country and identifying young talent for global competitions. 
 
 
 
• **Performance of SSCB:** 
 
 
• The **Services Sports Control Board** has consistently dominated the National Games due to its well-structured sports programs for armed forces personnel. 
 
• SSCB athletes are known for their rigorous training and discipline, often excelling in sports requiring physical endurance and technical precision. 
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Performances in 2025:** 
 
 
• **Maharashtra** and **Haryana** also performed exceptionally well, securing high medal tallies in various disciplines, including wrestling, hockey, and swimming. 
 
• Maharashtra secured the **2nd rank** with a total of **201 medals**, showcasing its dominance in multiple events. 
 
 
 
• **Importance of National Games:** 
 
 
• The Games play a pivotal role in identifying and nurturing talent for international competitions like the **Commonwealth Games**, **Asian Games**, and **Olympics**. 
 
• It also serves as a platform to promote grassroots sports and encourage youth participation in sporting activities. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 
 
• **SSCB's Legacy:** 
 
 
• SSCB has historically dominated the National Games due to its focus on disciplines like athletics, wrestling, boxing, and shooting. 
 
• Their athletes undergo systematic training, often competing at national and international levels. 
 
 
 
• **Uttarakhand as Host:** 
 
 
• The state of **Uttarakhand** was chosen as the host for the 38th National Games, marking its debut in organizing such a large-scale event. 
 
• The event saw the participation of over **10,000 athletes** and officials, making it a grand affair. 
 
 
 
• **Future Prospects:** 
 
 
• Many athletes identified during the Games are expected to represent India in upcoming international events, contributing to the country's sporting achievements.
